description: Encode a value into any of 35 barcode and QR symbologies and return the rendered image. Supports QR Code, Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec, EAN-13, UPC-A, Code 128/39/93, ITF-14 and more. Returns SVG markup by default (or a data: URI when asked), plus a link to the online generator pre-filled with the same value. Use "type" with the canonical name from list_barcode_types; common spellings like "qr" or "code-128" are accepted. Linear formats such as EAN-13 enforce strict charset and length rules and will fail on invalid input.

caption.description: Optional human-readable text drawn under the symbol. Defaults to the value itself.

errorCorrection.description: QR error-correction level. Higher levels survive more damage but produce a denser symbol. Ignored by linear formats.

format.description: Output encoding. "svg" returns XML markup; "data-uri" returns a ready-to-embed data: URL.

height.description: Symbol height in pixels (linear formats mainly).

showText.description: Draw the human-readable caption under the symbol.

value.description: The data to encode — a URL, product number, tracking code, phone number, Wi-Fi string, etc.

name: generate_barcode
title: Generate barcode
